transforms: Read SAS XPORT files for DEMO/BMX/GHB/TCHOL/HDL/GLU/BPXO (DEMO n=9254).
Restricted dim_participant and facts to MEC-examined adults RIDAGEYR>=18 and RIDSTATR=2 (n=5533); interview-only and age<18 rows excluded from the analytic universe and logged here.
Nulled DMDEDUC2 in {7,9} and INDHHIN2 in {77,99} (refused / don't know). Nulled INDFMPIR >= 10.
Melted four lab files into fact_lab (one row per participant × analyte) and dropped rows with missing numeric values.
Joined first oscillometric BP reading (BPXOSY1/BPXODI1) and body measures onto fact_exam.
Attached published NHANES codebook labels for sex, RIDRETH3, DMDEDUC2, INDHHIN2.

fact_exam.csv.description: Anthropometry and first-reading oscillometric blood pressure for MEC-examined adults.

fields.name: bmi
fields.description: Body mass index (kg/m2); null if not measured

fields.name: weight_kg
fields.description: Body weight in kilograms; null if not measured

fields.name: height_cm
fields.description: Standing height in centimetres; null if not measured

fields.name: waist_cm
fields.description: Waist circumference in centimetres; null if not measured

fields.name: systolic_mmhg
fields.description: First oscillometric systolic BP (mm Hg); null if not measured

fields.name: diastolic_mmhg
fields.description: First oscillometric diastolic BP (mm Hg); null if not measured

fact_lab.csv.description: Tidy laboratory results (HbA1c, lipids, fasting glucose) for the same adults.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Numeric laboratory result in dim_analyte.unit; rows with missing values dropped

dim_participant.csv.description: Survey demographics, poverty ratio, and design weights. Grain: one examined adult.

fields.name: education_code

fields.name: poverty_ratio
fields.description: Family income-to-poverty ratio (INDFMPIR); values >=10 treated as missing

dim_analyte.csv.description: Analyte codebook with units and LOINC.

dim_code.csv.description: Labels for sex, race/ethnicity, education, and household income codes.
